title: List the mailing addresses and names of public high schools (SOC = 66) that
question: List the mailing addresses and names of public high schools (SOC = 66) that have an SAT excellence rate above 0.25 and a K-12 to Ages 5–17 enrollment difference greater than the average such difference among locally funded schools.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_053", T2."XCL_047"
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_041"
INNER JOIN satscores AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_030"
WHERE T2."XCL_068" = '66'
  AND CAST(T3."XCL_040" AS REAL) / T3."XCL_036" > 0.25
  AND (T1."XCL_019" - T1."XCL_024") > (
    SELECT AVG(T4."XCL_019" - T4."XCL_024")
    FROM frpm AS T4
    INNER JOIN schools AS T5 ON T4."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_041"
    WHERE T5."XCL_065" = 'Locally funded'
  )
